public.title: Test Runner II
public.description: input is a tree forest of suite {kind:"suite",name,children} and test {kind:"test",name,actual,expected} descriptors. Visit tests depth-first in child order. Return {name,pass}; full names join suite and test names with " / ". Pass uses exact JSON serialization equality (object key order matters). No hooks or async callbacks in this version. Descriptor depth at most 6. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, fixtures and reference solutions, 2026. Covers a common JavaScript practice topic; no third-party exercise text or implementation copied.

explanation: Depth-first traversal builds full test names and evaluates leaf assertions. O(nodes times depth plus assertion bytes), O(depth plus output) space. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
